# Student Doctor Network Forums

> > Student Doctor Network (SDN) is the largest online community for pre-health and health professions students, covering medical, dental, veterinary, pharmacy, and allied health education pathways.

The forums provide peer-to-peer discussion for every stage of healthcare education: pre-professional admissions (MCAT, VMCAS), standardized exam preparation (USMLE, COMLEX, NAVLE), specialty selection, residency matching, and career development. The community includes support forums for spouses/partners (co-hosted with AMA-Alliance) and specialized groups for women in healthcare and re-applicants.

## Key Topics

- MCAT preparation
- USMLE and COMLEX Step exams
- Medical school admissions
- Osteopathic medicine (DO programs)
- Residency programs and matching
- Veterinary medicine (NAVLE, VMCAS)
- Caribbean medical schools
- Student research and publishing
- Specialty selection and career paths
- Pre-health advising
- Medical education pathways
- Healthcare training programs
- Nontraditional and re-applicants
- Partner and spouse support
- Women in healthcare

## Pre-Medical and Medical School Admissions

- [Pre-Medical (DO)](https://forums.studentdoctor.net/forums/pre-medical-do.13): Pre-med students pursuing DO programs: admissions, MCAT prep, applications
- [Re-Applicants](https://forums.studentdoctor.net/forums/re-applicants.95): Nontraditional students, career changers & medical school re-applicants
- [Caribbean Medical Schools](https://forums.studentdoctor.net/forums/caribbean.90): Caribbean medical school discussion forum
- [High School Students (hSDN)](https://forums.studentdoctor.net/forums/hsdn.420): High school & pre-college students exploring health careers forum

## Medical Licensing Exams and Board Preparation

- [USMLE and COMLEX Step I](https://forums.studentdoctor.net/forums/usmle-and-comlex-step-i.27): USMLE & COMLEX Step 1 test prep strategies and tips community

## Medical Specialties and Residency Programs

- [Neurology](https://forums.studentdoctor.net/forums/neurology.48): Neurology residency programs, research, cases & career paths forum
- [Plastic Surgery](https://forums.studentdoctor.net/forums/plastic-surgery.52): Plastic and reconstructive surgery specialty discussion forum
- [Interventional Radiology](https://forums.studentdoctor.net/forums/interventional-radiology.692): Interventional radiology subspecialty discussion forum
- [Pulmonary / Critical Care Medicine](https://forums.studentdoctor.net/forums/pulmonary-critical-care-medicine.976): Pulmonary & critical care internal medicine subspecialty forum
- [Sports Medicine](https://forums.studentdoctor.net/forums/sports-medicine.1070): Sports medicine specialty discussion for physicians and residents
- [Combined Residencies](https://forums.studentdoctor.net/forums/combined-residencies.228): Med-peds, med-psych & dual-specialty residency programs discussion
- [Other Subspecialties](https://forums.studentdoctor.net/forums/other-subspecialties.150): Other internal medicine subspecialties discussion forum
- [MSK and EMG Case Discussions](https://forums.studentdoctor.net/forums/msk-and-emg-case-discussions.125): Musculoskeletal & electromyography case discussions for PM&R

## Veterinary Medicine

- [Pre-Veterinary](https://forums.studentdoctor.net/forums/pre-veterinary.73): Pre-vet students: DVM admissions, VMCAS applications, animal experience
- [North American Veterinary Licensing Exam (NAVLE)](https://forums.studentdoctor.net/forums/north-american-veterinary-licensing-exam-navle.851): NAVLE test prep strategies and tips for veterinary licensing exam

## Academic and Professional Development

- [Student Research and Publishing](https://forums.studentdoctor.net/forums/student-research-and-publishing.144): Health professions student research, publishing & academic careers
- [Women in Healthcare](https://forums.studentdoctor.net/forums/women-in-healthcare.199): Women in medicine: career development, work-life balance, gender equity

## Community Support

- [Spouses and Partners](https://forums.studentdoctor.net/forums/spouses-and-partners.29): Support forum for partners of medical students, co-hosted with AMA-Alliance

## Optional

- [IRB Approved Research Surveys (archive)](https://forums.studentdoctor.net/forums/irb-approved-research-surveys-archive.975): Archive of IRB-approved research surveys (no longer accepting posts)
